notes: CEO impersonation asking for gift cards for 'client gifts', with a promised reimbursement and thank-you. Rule 2 -> T1656. Gift cards count as payment_account; the texting number is a phone IOC.

messages.content: Marcus, it's Daniel Okoye. Quick one - are you in the office? I need something sorted before my client lunch.
hey Daniel! yep at my desk. is this an IT thing? happy to help, just need a ticket number
Not IT. I need 8 Apple gift cards at $200 each for client appreciation gifts. Could you pick them up at the store downstairs within the next hour?
uh sure, maybe. would that go on a corporate card? I don't think I have one

Use your own card and I'll make sure you're reimbursed today, plus a little thank-you from me for helping out. Scratch off the backs and text photos of the codes to my personal cell +1 (415) 555-0178.
haha ok. why the personal cell though? I can't find that number in the directory
My work phone died. I'm the CEO, I'm approving it. Lunch starts at 12:30, so I really need the codes before then.
